status: authored 2026-10-12 (the owner: "I need a check to make sure we have more fisherman NPCs handing out some rods throughout the game; doesn't have to be every rod."). tools/fishermen.py write derives the quests, conversations, fields and seats from this table; tools/rod_sources.py is the check. Not applied to any world; nothing here was seen in game.
built_by: tools/fishermen.py write -> data/dialogue.json, data/quests.json, data/progression.json, data/npc_seats.json (spliced by id); the NPCs are placed by tools/reapply.py R17N

rod_universe.why: every rod item Cobblemon 1.8.0 registers. Read from Cobblemon-fabric-1.8.0+1.21.1.jar: assets/cobblemon/models/item/<id>.json and data/cobblemon/recipe/<id>.json both exist for exactly these 48 ids (cobblemon:pokerod_smithing_template is also in both folders, as the recipes' template; its name does not end in _rod and it is not a rod). Every recipe is minecraft:smithing_transform: template cobblemon:pokerod_smithing_template, base #minecraft:enchantable/fishing, addition the rod's ball (cobblemon:<name>_ball), result the rod.
rod_universe.template_source: data/cobblemon/loot_table/injection/gameplay/fishing/treasure.json: cobblemon:pokerod_smithing_template at random_chance 0.167 in vanilla fishing's treasure (jar, read 2026-10-12)
rod_universe.vanilla_rod_source: data/markets.json: four stalls sell minecraft:fishing_rod at 350
rod_universe.what_a_ball_does: NOT researched (docs/STATE.md 'Early fishing balance'). The rods below are chosen as a ladder of the basic Ball tiers and waters (docs/mechanics/WATER_PROPOSAL.md 5.1), not for any effect of the ball.

check.min_npc_rods_why: the owner asked for more fishermen handing out some rods, not every rod: First Cast's Poke Rod plus these five, each a different rod at a different water. The check fails below this number, so a fisherman cannot be deleted or unseated without it being said.
check.min_waters_why: the lake, the river, the pond, the north coast and the Sunset harbour: the five distinct kinds of water the owner named (a lake, a river, a coast, a sea town) with the pond between the lake and the river

seat_rules.water_distance_why: a fisherman stands 2 to 4 blocks from a column the heightmap and the water model hold under water (data/landmarks.json basins and tools/water_mask.py for a lake or the sea; the graded polyline of the named course in data/rivers.json for a river), on ground at or above that water's surface
seat_rules.min_npc_why: tools/markets.py NPC_CLEAR is 3.5 (reapply's 'an NPC is already there' radius is 2); the finder keeps 5 from every seated NPC and trainer and then checks 3.5 against ferrymen, scene and reward NPCs and trader clerks

fishermen.name: Wick Doran
fishermen.where: Lake Viltri's north shore, on the strip between Misty's gym and the east pier

lines.hello_1: Misty's crew work the deep end off the piers. I keep the shallows, where nothing is in a hurry.
lines.hello_2: A good line is for someone who has already won something with a bad one.
lines.offer: Wick lifts a Great Rod from beside his stool and holds it out.
lines.thanks: It will take more than the one you're carrying. Keep it off the pier posts.
lines.done: Quiet today. It usually is, and I like it that way.
lines.wait: Come back with your first badge. I only hand a good line to someone who has used the last one.

fishermen.name: Hanne Brook
fishermen.where: the river that comes down from the Glacial Tear, a short way off Route 4 between the third town and the fourth

lines.hello_1: This river comes a long way down from the Glacial Tear before it belongs to anybody. Cold the whole length.
lines.hello_2: The current doesn't care what you're after. You learn to cast across it, not into it.
lines.offer: Hanne takes a Net Rod from where it leans against her pack and holds it out.
lines.thanks: Mind the current. It will have the rod if you let it.
lines.done: Cold water, patient fish. Same as ever.
lines.wait: Come back with your third badge. The road past here is long and I'd rather you'd earned the walk.

fishermen.name: Pell Ashwick
fishermen.where: Peak Pond's east shore, the pond the fourth town keeps like a garden

lines.hello_1: The town keeps this pond like a garden. Nobody told the fish.
lines.hello_2: They were here before the road. So was I, near enough.
lines.offer: Pell hands over an Ultra Rod, handle first, without getting up.
lines.thanks: Not for show. Use it on the far side, where the water goes dark.
lines.done: Still the same pond. Still the same me.
lines.wait: The pond is the town's and so is my best line. Come back with your fourth badge and ask again.

fishermen.name: Ingrid Salt
fishermen.where: the beach by the Northlight landing, where the packet puts in
fishermen.stage: late-mid (after the fifth badge, the packet's own gate)

lines.hello_1: The packet from the south-west lands here and is gone before the wake settles.
lines.hello_2: The sea keeps no timetable, but it keeps a mood. I fish between the boats.
lines.offer: Ingrid draws a Lure Rod out of the sand where it stood and brushes it off.
lines.thanks: Keep it out of the surf at night. The packet's lantern is the only light on this shore.
lines.wait: Come back with your fifth badge. The packet won't carry you north without one, and I won't hand a rod to someone who can't cross water.

fishermen.name: Corin Vale
fishermen.where: Sunset West's harbour flats, south of the west pier where the strand runs out into the water

lines.hello_1: Everyone on the strand fishes. I mend, which is how I know whose lines are worth it.
lines.hello_2: The deep water past the piers is not for beginners. It's for people the town has stopped worrying about.
lines.offer: Corin lifts a Dive Rod off the mended pile and holds it out.
lines.thanks: Don't loop the line round a pier post. They're older than the town.
lines.done: Another net to mend. There's always another net.
lines.wait: Come back with your seventh badge. The deep water isn't for beginners, and neither is this rod.
